definitions: A person who leaves home to lead a dissolute life and squander their inheritance but eventually returns repentant.
A person who returns after a long absence, often having wasted their resources or behaved recklessly.
examples: The family welcomed the Prodigal Son back with open arms.
He was seen as the Prodigal Son, returning after years abroad.
The company celebrated the return of its Prodigal Son, who had left to start his own venture.
